name: html-briefing
description: Evidence-led HTML briefings with a default flow canvas, presenter-controlled zoom, progressive disclosure and long-form reading; optional visual helpers and browser verification.

interface.shortDescription: Flow-canvas HTML briefings and evidence-led storytelling
interface.longDescription: One storytelling lead combines Impeccable, UI UX Pro Max, ImageGen and the eight GSAP modules as needed. Use host Visualize for conversation previews and browser tools or Playwright for final offline verification. Ordinary writing and coding use the agent’s abilities. No mandatory full-suite execution.
